name: lat-md
description: The lat.md knowledge-graph plugin, published from the fork that builds it.

plugins.name: lat-md
plugins.description: Grounds an agent in a project's lat.md/ knowledge graph deterministically, via hooks rather than by asking the agent to remember: resolves [[refs]] and federates tagged knowledge into every prompt, blocks a multi-line rationale comment before it reaches source, regenerates directory indexes after edits, and blocks Stop on a failing lat check — including Diataxis mode validation.
